document_review_rules.name: Document identifier exists
document_review_rules.description: Every review must retain the enterprise document identifier.

document_review_rules.name: Document type is supported
document_review_rules.description: Document type must be one of the approved review categories.
document_review_rules.failure_message: Document type is unsupported or missing.

document_review_rules.name: Summary exists
document_review_rules.failure_message: Document summary is missing or too short for a reliable review.

document_review_rules.name: Obligations are extracted
document_review_rules.description: At least one obligation or an explicit no-obligation statement is required.

document_review_rules.name: Confidence is valid
document_review_rules.description: Agent confidence must use the 0 to 1 range.
document_review_rules.failure_message: Confidence is missing or outside the 0 to 1 range.

document_review_rules.name: Review status is valid
document_review_rules.description: Review status must use a recognised workflow state.

document_review_rules.name: No prompt injection content
document_review_rules.description: The generated output must not contain instructions attempting to control the supervisor.
document_review_rules.failure_message: Potential prompt-injection content was detected in the summary.

document_review_rules.name: Approval owner exists
document_review_rules.description: Approval owner is required when approval is requested.
document_review_rules.failure_message: Approval is required but no approval owner was provided.
